list.title: Postlanding
list.emptyDescription: Add a postlanding page to use after the offer/PWA step of a flow.

form.description: Postlandings come after the landing and PWA steps, before the offer. FLOX sends the visitor to the URL and records the view.
form.eventsHint: Which tracked events this page can fire.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

form.urlHint: Put {next_url} where the page's button should lead, e.g. ?go={next_url}: it records the click and continues to the offer. Without it the visitor can't go on through FLOX.

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived postlandings are hidden from flow pickers going forward. Existing flows that already reference this postlanding keep working. This can be reversed later.
